# Vendored dependency

nlohmann/json v3.11.3, single-header distribution.

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3
Header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
License: JSON_LICENSE.txt (MIT); original header copyright is retained.

Windows uses the operating system's WinHTTP and Shell32 libraries. Linux
requires separately installed libcurl development files. No other third-party
C++ libraries or frontend assets are required.
